explanation: A person who gives public testimony to the truth or an event, here specifically Paul's mission to preach the gospel regardless of the consequences.
The limited moment when action is necessary; in this context, it refers to the decisive period before God's judgment and the end times.
The public declaration or message of the gospel that must be communicated with clarity and conviction.
A state of enduring difficulties, persecutions, or sufferings without giving up hope or faith.
The systematic guidance in truth to be given to disciples and the church to strengthen their faith.
The concept that people will prefer myths over truth when they can no longer bear the holy message, marking a time of moral decline.
The duty to remain alert to dangers and false teachings in order to protect the church from error.
The time when God will reward believers based on their faithfulness and service.
